payload.title: GPT 第九轮 Z0/Z1/Z2 验证：Z0 成立，Z1/Z2 被否；现有观测内控制器搜索正式封闭

payload.scope: GPT round-9 Z0/Z1/Z2 validation under DEC-022 (no new observations)

verdicts.Z0 NFATSR: CONFIRMED numerically (const adversarial N6 == (q*)^N exactly; Chebyshev amplified 89x/372x). Elementary proof, adjacent to regret-optimal control -> modest novelty, better as one section of a characterization paper.
verdicts.Z1 ERCRC: KILLED - tail error worsens (P2 q95 0.192 vs 0.027; P1 q95 0.475 vs 0.204), memory grows unbounded (max 281), naive clip not better. All 3 self-set kill criteria met.
verdicts.Z2 REIC: KILLED - geometric-median aggregation improves inverse-command error only ~2.5-5% (threshold 20%); failures correlated; prior-art mature.

payload.round9_outcome: no controller route passes gate v0.3; but Z0 is a valid negative/limit result
payload.lockdown_chain: bulk strongly monotone + constraints inactive + no output/task nullspace + no low-order residual dynamics + Newton/secant occupied + polynomial acceleration killed by time-variation + best constant gain minimax-optimal + tail-robust recycling ineffective + inverse aggregation ineffective + robust/DLS/IQC/Hinf/funnel/sliding/conformal classical + new observations forbidden (DEC-022)
payload.conclusion: Under current observations and gate v0.3, no empirically-motivated non-classical controller route remains.
payload.recommended: A' characterization/impossibility paper (no new observations required): learned response geometry + no-free-acceleration + empirical falsification of Y3/Z1/Z2 + constant-gain response feedback more robust than deployed Koopman+LQR.
